batch_patterns.evidence: keys run D,D,D,D on the first four items of the canning lecture; over the batch A is the key on only 6 of 40 (B 11, C 12, D 11). Mild; length is balanced (key uniquely longest 8/40, uniquely shortest 8/40).

in each, two options share a long frame and differ only in the deciding detail (9 decide later / agrees at last; 14 Twenty on three days / Twenty single test; 26 smaller / larger; 30 club will vote / choosing the letter), and the key is always one of the pair; the other two options are far off, so a student can narrow to 50% without listening. Counter-case: 18 (pair Unsure/Unsure, key outside it).

both conversation gist items key the deferred outcome ("which they will decide later" / "that the club will vote on") against a near-twin that says the matter was settled; 2 of 4 conversation gist items.
